_what_this_is: CONFOUNDS PRESENT IN RUNS THAT HAVE ALREADY COMPLETED. His ruling of 2026-10-11:
"No one ever said we should go back and 'fake the record'. Like every confound, or
deficit we find, when we find them, we mark them explicitly in our docs and correct
them going forward. Verdict fix it. Do exactly that."
So an archived run's config is NEVER edited. The confound is recorded HERE, against
the named runs it affected, and the defect is corrected only in configs that have not
yet run. A guard asserts that no entry here is silently removed and that no archived

what: burst_mode was pinned to "off" in 43 of 47 experiment configs. Burst logic is part
of the iterative-restart machinery, and his ruling of 2026-10-05 was "It shouldnt be
off as far as I am concerned. The ITC machinery is one of the more effective methods
of finding and resolving problems we uncovered."
effect_on_the_affected_runs: Every run below executed WITHOUT burst logic. Any convergence or non-convergence they
report was measured on a runner missing that facility, so those results understate
what the full machinery would do. They are not invalid; they are narrower than they
look, and must be quoted with this confound named.
corrected_going_forward: 10 configs that had not yet run were set to "auto" on 2026-10-11. burst_mode was
verified NOT to be a factor in the exp52 2x2 factorial first -- its factors are
divergence_channel_enabled and feedback_channel_enabled, and burst was held constant
at "off" across all 4 cells, so correcting it changes the held level rather than the
design. An earlier claim that the 5 factorial configs were a design decision was
confounds.runner_default: auto, and the runner gates on `!= "off"` (reference_runner_v3.py:15667)
